QuestInfo.name: Mai's Training
QuestInfo.0: #b#p11##k at #b#m50##k seems like a martial arts specialist who can train beginners.
QuestInfo.1: I am now under the tutelage of the famous sword master, #b#p11##k, in #b#m50##k. For my first lesson, she told me to hunt #r#o3#s#k, #r#o4#s#k, and #r#o5#s#k. Ah, #b#p11##k also said to meet up with #b#p12##k in #b#m60##k for a useful quest.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p11##k trained you, and you feel stronger.

0.0: Hmm, you look like you're in serious need of my guidance. Is it your first time here? What you need more than anything right now is FOCUS. So...want me to train you?

yes.0: It's simple actually. All you need to do right now is hunt monsters. I'll assign you a few tasks, and you'll be surprised to see how much you grow.
yes.1: Head out of town, and you'll run into lots of monsters. The weakest is the #r#o3##k, a tiny blue snail, and it's a piece of cake. Next are the #r#o4#s#k and the #r#o5#s#k. Listen, hunt weaker monsters until you can handle bigger, stronger, and faster monsters. It's all about hunting the right ones.
yes.2: Your training task is to defeat 10 #r#o3##k, 10 #r#o4##k, and 5 #r#o5##k and then return. It may seem tough at first, but you'll be able to do it quickly, so don't worry. Just remember to start with the weaker ones and take it slow! Staying calm is the key to hunting!
yes.3: Oh, and press #bW#k to see the World Map and locate #b#m60##k. Go there and meet #b#p12##k. He may have something for you. You can accept #b#p12##k's quest while training with me, so I suggest you meet him pronto.

no.0: Hmm... So, you don't want to receive training? It's good that you have so much confidence. But if you change your mind, come talk to me again.

1.0: Have you been training by preying on the weak? Let me see...

mob.0: I don't think you understood what I told you. You haven't defeated enough monsters. You can check your quest progress in the Quest Log, right?
